Row.Text: A 128 by 128 procedural world. Native maximum-size validation is in progress. Requires an oversized-map provider such as YnAMP.

Calendar advances 10 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/10 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/10 as many turns, rounded up. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.

Calendar advances 20 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/20 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/20 as many turns, rounded up. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
A large 128 by 80 procedural world using native-compatible dimensions. Requires an oversized-map provider such as YnAMP.

4,400 annual Antiquity turns, 5,400 seasonal Exploration turns, and 2,400 monthly Modern turns, ending December 1949. Research, civics and celebrations follow the extended ages. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
Calendar advances twice as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use half the Realistic costs/durations; ages take half as many turns. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
